# BoxPanel { #anylumino.BoxPanel }

```python
BoxPanel(
    widgets=None,
    *,
    titles=None,
    keys=None,
    direction='left-to-right',
    spacing=8,
    stretches=None,
    width='100%',
    height=420,
    resizable=True,
    scroll=False,
    scroll_x=None,
    scroll_y=None,
    child_min_width=None,
    child_min_height=None,
)
```

Lumino box layout with configurable direction, spacing, and stretch.

``HBox`` and ``VBox`` are direction-specific convenience subclasses. Set
``scroll=True`` to enable scrolling along the natural box direction, or use
``scroll_x`` and ``scroll_y`` for explicit overflow behavior.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                                                                         | Description                                                                                                                               | Default           |
|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| widgets          | iterable or mapping                                                          | Child anywidgets, ipywidgets, or owner objects exposing a ``widget`` attribute. Mapping keys become stable child keys and default titles. | `None`            |
| titles           | iterable or mapping                                                          | Optional labels associated with children. Mapping values are looked up by child key.                                                      | `None`            |
| keys             | iterable of str                                                              | Stable child keys for iterable ``widgets``.                                                                                               | `None`            |
| direction        | (\'left-to-right\', \'right-to-left\', \'top-to-bottom\', \'bottom-to-top\') | Lumino box direction.                                                                                                                     | `"left-to-right"` |
| spacing          | int                                                                          | Pixel spacing between children.                                                                                                           | `8`               |
| stretches        | iterable of int                                                              | Lumino stretch factors, one per child when provided.                                                                                      | `None`            |
| width            | int, float, str, or None                                                     | Widget width. Numeric values use the shared anylumino size rules.                                                                         | `'100%'`          |
| height           | int, float, str, or None                                                     | Widget height. Numeric values use the shared anylumino size rules.                                                                        | `420`             |
| resizable        | bool                                                                         | Whether the panel receives a notebook-friendly resize handle.                                                                             | `True`            |
| scroll           | bool                                                                         | Enables scrolling along the natural layout direction.                                                                                     | `False`           |
| scroll_x         | bool                                                                         | Explicit horizontal or vertical overflow controls.                                                                                        | `None`            |
| scroll_y         | bool                                                                         | Explicit horizontal or vertical overflow controls.                                                                                        | `None`            |
| child_min_width  | int, float, str, or None                                                     | Minimum child sizes used when scrolling is enabled.                                                                                       | `None`            |
| child_min_height | int, float, str, or None                                                     | Minimum child sizes used when scrolling is enabled.                                                                                       | `None`            |
